body:
Owner decision transcribed by Sol on 2026-09-24 from the active NEAR planning conversation.

The owner accepted a bounded extension of the existing edge-triage golden and agreed to this first-run trigger:

> Run the extended golden after beta.164 is published, pinned to that tag, with the documented prerequisites verified and the human participant and resource limits arranged.

The owner's follow-up was:

> agree - continue with prep and ensure we have inventories/evidence preserved so it survives outside session

Preparation continues in PR #1368. It applies the independently reviewed P2/N1 procedure to the existing golden, preserves the developer baseline and the two-hour human supplement, and retains the inventories, exact review identities, and evidence provenance in the repository. #1315 remains the execution tracker, in v1.0.0-rc.1; its first run pins to published `v1.0.0-beta.164` and records the resolved commit.

This accepts the audit direction and preparation. The candidate v1 objective and disposition of future findings remain separate owner decisions. No audit, model evaluation, recurring monitor, or implementation of findings is launched by this decision. This is a post-publication evaluation, not a condition for publishing beta.164.
